noun_definition: Book travel refers to the feature in the application that allows users to initiate travel booking actions from the interface.
Report screen refers to the interface displayed in the background that should remain unchanged when the Country field is clicked during the travel booking process.
Changes refers to the unintended alteration of the report screen to the profile page when the Country field is clicked during the booking travel process.
profile view refers to the display of user profile information that should remain unchanged when interacting with the Country field on the report screen during the travel booking process.
country field refers to the interactive element in the travel booking interface that allows users to select their country.
